feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера и прп. Веры исповедницы (1932)»

death.note: The year the day line prints for him and for the confessor Vera beside him at once, and the only year this calendar gives either of them.

names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 14199, «Димитрий (Благовещенский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank and grade words left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname. No other folder in this corpus holds this surname.
